top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The director's files is incomplete and does not have proof of orientation, DL/ID, pre-affidavit, nor an signed affidavit.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children (26 TAC §746.1701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver was observed in direct care of 11 children with three of those children being ages 0-17 months of age; the maximum number of children to be   supervised by one caregiver was 7, therefore the caregiver was over by 4 children.

top_violation_types.title: Smoke-Detection System Tested (26 TAC §746.5315)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have information on testing the carbon monoxide detection system.

top_violation_types.title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An updated immunization record is needed for one child enrolled.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Suspension and Expulsion (26 TAC §746.501(a)(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There is no policy for suspension and expulsion.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entrapment Openings (26 TAC §746.4601(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was a gap in the playground gate that was larger than 3 1/2 inches and smaller than 9 inches.
